integrity: The product beat-point classification and core multiplicativity are proved symbolically from the coordinatewise order, existence of maximal/minimal points in finite nonempty posets, and the standard core theorem. The finite enumeration is corroborative only. Literature noncoverage is asserted only relative to the inspected sources and recorded searches.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns strong homotopy reduction by beat points for nonempty finite \(T_0\)-spaces. It does not assert analogous multiplicativity for weak-point reductions, minimal weak models, simple-homotopy models, or graph-homomorphism cores. Some older literature was not available in full text and remains a residual originality risk.
title: Cartesian-product rigidity of cores of finite spaces
